diagnosis: Async QA ideas and existing Guide/Judge/portfolio machinery lacked one compact durable contract for splitting a candidate version into non-overlapping claimable verification slices. Without a shared semantic slice identity, spare workers can repeat the same inspection instead of covering distinct evidence classes.
intervention: Added a candidate orthogonal-verifier matrix with eight applicability-gated dimensions, shared result schema, existing-discoveryFingerprint semantic dedupe, explicit one-versus-N parallelism rules, fixture/harness, and a Preservation Contract. It reuses existing Guide successor pins, ordinary portfolio PIN authority, and existing Judge/source-owner authority; it does not create a scheduler, Judge, Current or promotion path.
tests: node scripts/check-guide-orthogonal-verifier-matrix-v1.mjs => PASS: 8 slices, 4 applicability cases, 3 dedupe cases, all assertions

remaining_boundary: Runtime materialization/automatic fan-out of these candidate slices is intentionally not activated by this job. Any later wiring remains a separate owned change and must preserve the existing worker hot path and authority boundaries. Direct live Current Tree Supabase read was tool-safety-blocked and not retried; durable owner fallback was sufficient for this candidate design.
